The '''Ministry of Logistics Freelance Rewards Program''' was a rewards program instituted by the [[Ministry of Logistics]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] to reward freelance agents of the Empire, such as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Section 47/b of the Freelance Enforcement edict stated that freelancers should receive rewards for bringing justice to fugitives from Imperial law.
